Goal `core-os-and-2-more`: every `Core\Os` member has all its feature proofs, and `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Os'` passes (check `dossier-core-os`).
`loadAverage`'s first example carries `// requires: unix`. Its `.out` was written from a run of the WSL binary (`/var/tmp/nvs-target-wsl/debug/nvs`), because `--bless` refuses a skipped example on Windows. Examples 2 and 3, the attack and the bench catch the Windows `RuntimeError` and run everywhere.
`pid` and `residentBytes` are credited to the Rust test `pid_hostname_cpu_count_resident_bytes_and_load_average_all_answer` by one comma-separated `covers:` line. Their cards were rewritten in the plain voice.
Still red: `dossier-core-out` and `dossier-core-password`. Neither class has a card, and none of their members has an example, an attack, a bench or a Rust `covers:` marker.

items.text: **`Core\Out::capture`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, a Rust `covers:` marker and the `Core\Out` class card (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/out.rs:62`. The card goes above the class's `CLASS` row, and `Core\Out` leaves `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5189`. `rule:security/capture-answers-the-carrier` says what the capture returns.

**`Core\Password::hash`, `verify` and `needsRehash`** — each owes about, examples, hostile, perf and a Rust `covers:` marker, and the class owes its card (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/password.rs:207`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/password.rs:216`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/password.rs:225`. A hash is different on every run, so an example prints a check and never the hash. A hash is slow on purpose, so the bench's iterations stay small.

**Record the figures** — `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Out'` and the same for `Core\Password`, after the benches exist (`rule:testing/member-perf-ledger`). `benches/members/core/Os/loadAverage.nvs:1` is a finished bench to compare with.
